Figure 1:Multi-stage construction pipeline of Game2Real-Bench.It comprises capability-guided task design, procedural generation and verification,
and mechanism-aligned real-world curation.

Figure 2:Capability-aligned tasks in Game2Real-Bench.Toy-game and real-world tasks span fine-grained perception, spatial
reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We present
representative QA samples illustrating shared reasoning requirements
across the two settings.

Figure 6:Failure cases on Game2Real-Bench.Model reasoning traces are compared with verified solutions for Block
Counting, Hexakai, and Mancala. These cases illustrate three recurring
failures: misinterpreting spatial structure, inconsistent relational
reasoning, and unreliable state updating.
